registration_note: This protocol was frozen after exploratory results from 2017-2019 and 2020-2022 had been inspected. It is not a preregistration for those data and applies only prospectively to a future eligible untouched holdout.
research_question: Does training-label construction under incomplete follow-up change mortgage-default prediction, model ranking, calibration, or hypothetical review-cost decisions?
primary_hypotheses: Naive labels with immature loans included differ from complete-horizon labels in discrimination or Brier score on a common mature evaluation cohort.
Label strategy can change model rankings or validation-threshold-based hypothetical decision costs; direction and practical relevance are empirical questions, not assumed.

training.survival_model: delayed-entry cause-specific Cox for default and voluntary payoff
training.preprocessing_fit_scope: training cohort separately for each model, strategy, and horizon
training.hyperparameters: fixed pilot settings; no tuning on validation or test cohorts

uses: threshold selection for the prespecified hypothetical cost grid
any future model selection or calibration, if explicitly added before opening the holdout

evaluation.eligible_holdout_rule: Use only a future, not previously inspected vintage range with adequate observed follow-up for the full 36-month horizon; ascertain eligibility from raw outcome coverage before examining model performance. Existing vintages through 2024 are not eligible because of prior outcome-coverage inspection or inadequate 36-month maturity.
evaluation.common_population: At each horizon, compare approaches on identical horizon-mature loans, requiring acquisition entry at month 1 for binary comparisons; voluntary payoff is a non-default competing outcome and early other termination is excluded from complete-case binary evaluation.
secondary_metrics: cause-specific concordance and censor-aware time-dependent metrics when estimable under documented assumptions
evaluation.uncertainty: 1000 paired loan bootstrap replicates, resampled within vintage; percentile 95% intervals; report full-sample observed differences
evaluation.multiplicity: No multiplicity correction; all intervals are descriptive and must not be interpreted as confirmatory p-values.
evaluation.decision_rule: Report rankings and interval estimates. Do not claim a material label-handling effect unless ranking, metric, calibration, and cost evidence are consistent and practically interpretable.

decision_costs.threshold_rule: Choose the threshold minimizing validation cost over exact observed score boundaries plus a threshold above the maximum score for the zero-review action; decisions use probability >= threshold; ties choose the highest threshold.
decision_costs.assumption_status: Hypothetical normalized sensitivity scenarios; no lender-specific utility evidence or observed dollar loss estimates support these ratios.

prohibited: Fitting or refitting a model using holdout outcomes
Selecting features, transformations, hyperparameters, calibration, thresholds, or scenarios using holdout results
Describing previously inspected vintages as untouched or confirmatory
holdout_integrity.after_any_method_change_post_holdout: The affected holdout analysis becomes exploratory; a new untouched holdout is required for confirmatory claims.

observation_limitations: Performance histories begin at Freddie Mac acquisition; delayed entry cannot reconstruct pre-acquisition performance.
Cause-specific survival estimates are conditional on observed entry and the stated competing-risk/censoring assumptions.
